experiment_data.hypothesis: Multi-task persuasion loss weight (lambda) affects OOD generalization in E2E fine-tuning: lambda=0 (intent-only) will underperform on hard OOD (ActorAttack) compared to lambda>0, because the persuasion auxiliary signal provides a regularization effect that preserves OOD-relevant features in the encoder. There exists an optimal lambda that maximizes AA OOD without sacrificing IID performance.
